verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents built-in agents for Customer Screening/Ongoing Monitoring and Transaction Monitoring. These agents take on compliance work by auto-remediating level 1 alerts and escalating high-risk cases to humans, a real form of delegation inside the product. The evidence is thin marketing copy, though, and the agent configurations on the Starter Plan are standardized and cannot be customized. Missing for 10: an interactive assistant to which users can hand ad-hoc tasks, documentation of how users direct or configure the agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
